extensions.name: ASUS
extensions.description: Performance profiles, fan curves, battery charge limit, firmware settings, Aura keyboard lighting, the Slash lightbar and AniMe Matrix.
extensions.devices: ASUS ROG, TUF, Zephyrus and other laptops supported by asusctl

extensions.name: Logitech
extensions.description: Battery, pointer speed, scrolling, buttons, backlight, Easy-Switch and lighting for Logitech mice and keyboards.
extensions.devices: Logitech HID++ mice, keyboards and Unifying, Bolt and Lightspeed receivers

extensions.name: Headsets
extensions.description: Battery, sidetone, lights, equalizer presets and auto power-off for gaming headsets.
extensions.devices: SteelSeries Arctis, HyperX Cloud, Corsair Void, Logitech G and Roccat headsets supported by HeadsetControl

extensions.name: Webcams
extensions.description: A live preview, microphone level and mic options (never idle, default, unmuted) for USB webcams, plus zoom, pan and tilt, focus, exposure and white balance. OBSBOT Tiny 3 cameras can be kept awake.
extensions.devices: OBSBOT, Logitech, Elgato and other UVC webcams

extensions.name: Corsair
extensions.description: Lighting for Corsair keyboards, mice, headsets, memory and fan hubs through OpenRGB: effects, colour, brightness, speed and following the theme colour, plus device details and access for Corsair Web Hub.
extensions.devices: Corsair keyboards (Galleon 100 SD and others), mice, headsets and stands, memory and fan or LED hubs that OpenRGB supports

extensions.name: Stream Deck
extensions.description: The Galleon 100 SD's built-in Stream Deck: keys, profiles, pages, brightness and dials, run by galleon-deck.
extensions.devices: Corsair Galleon 100 SD's built-in Stream Deck

extensions.name: RGB lighting
extensions.description: Lighting for every RGB device OpenRGB sees: one colour everywhere, the theme colour, saved profiles, and each device's effects, brightness and speed.
extensions.devices: Motherboards, memory, graphics cards, coolers, LED strips, keyboards, mice and headsets from any brand OpenRGB supports

extensions.name: Monitors
extensions.description: Brightness, contrast, speaker volume, input switching, colour preset and power for external monitors, on the monitor itself.
extensions.devices: External monitors with DDC/CI (most desktop monitors over DisplayPort, HDMI or USB-C)

extensions.name: Laptop
extensions.description: Battery health and charge limits, power profile, keyboard light, and microphone and camera switches.
extensions.devices: Laptops of any brand that use the kernel's standard battery and power controls: ThinkPad, Dell, Framework, HP, LG, Lenovo, Huawei, Samsung and others (ASUS laptops use the ASUS extension)

extensions.name: NVIDIA
extensions.description: Temperature, use, memory, clocks and power of NVIDIA graphics, the programs using it, the power limit and persistence mode.
extensions.devices: NVIDIA GeForce, RTX and Quadro cards with the NVIDIA driver

extensions.name: Game controllers
extensions.description: Battery, a live button, stick and trigger tester, a rumble test, and the lightbar and player lights of PlayStation controllers.
extensions.devices: Xbox, PlayStation (DualSense, DualShock 4), Switch Pro, 8BitDo and other controllers the kernel drives, over USB or Bluetooth

extensions.name: Drawing tablets
extensions.description: Which screen the pen draws on, the area of the tablet used, matching the screen's shape, left-handed and mouse-like use.
extensions.devices: Wacom, XP-Pen, Huion, Gaomon and other tablets Hyprland supports
